Coalesce any `NaN` values in $Q_v$ to negative infinity ($-\infty$) to handle division by zero or invalid inputs.

- **Negative $Q_v$ Components:** If any component of $Q_v$ is negative, the ray originates outside the cube or points away from the relevant face, yielding no valid entry/exit within the box bounds defined by the logic.
- **All Negative $Q_v$:** If all components of $Q_v$ are negative, the ray does not intersect the cube in the forward direction.
- **Division by Zero:** If `raydir[i]` is 0, the division results in infinity or NaN.
- **When Not to Use:** When only a boolean intersection test is required (use [Ray-box intersection](776-ray-box-intersection.md) or a simpler AABB test).
